record.question: Food pattern refers to:
options: Eating behaviour, types, frequency and quantity of food
record.explanation: Answer B: Eating behaviour, types, frequency and quantity of food. A dietary/food pattern refers to the combination and types of foods habitually consumed over time; the offered option B best captures types, frequency, and quantity. Reference: https://www.fao.org/fileadmin/user_upload/faoterm/PDF/Nutrition_glossary-web_2022.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
